name: unoebasta
description: A single web page with text and audio links for Hugo, Nebula and Locus winners. No app, no server, no accounts.

scripts.test: node --test test/pipeline.test.mjs test/research.test.mjs test/contributions.test.mjs && node test/ui.test.js
scripts.audio:plan: node scripts/research.mjs plan --lang all --kind audio --providers youtube,akniga,librivox,publisher --limit 40 --out .cache/search/audio-plan.json
